GhostTalk is an accessible communication app (AAC). To let you use all features like speech output, calls, weather reports, and smart home, we will now set up the required permissions.
For core functions of the app, we need some standard permissions from your device. Already granted permissions are shown in green. Click on a permission to see more details.
Required for the AI Eye feature (Gemini Vision) to capture and describe images with the camera.
Required to record custom voice recordings to use as button sounds.
Required to launch phone calls directly via buttons, select contacts for speed dial buttons, and detect incoming calls.
Allows sending pre-configured SMS messages to selected contacts at the press of a button.
Allows the app to read upcoming events from your calendar out loud.
Required to determine your current location for the weather report.
This permission allows the app to display on top of other apps. This is strictly required to show the call overlay or to dim the screen.
By accessing notifications, GhostTalk can read incoming messages from apps like WhatsApp or Signal out loud. You can choose which apps to read in the settings.
To answer and hang up calls directly through GhostTalk (e.g. using switches), GhostTalk must be registered as your default phone app.
All important settings have been configured. You are now ready to use GhostTalk.

Most Frequent Action (Rank %1$d):\nDynamically determines the most frequently executed action at rank %1$d and executes it.
Previous Action (Rank %1$d):\nExecutes the %1$d. last executed action from the history.
Smart Prediction (Rank %1$d, Type: %2$s):\nOffers the rank %1$d prediction based on the current context.
Auditory Cue (Most Frequent Action):\nSpeaks the name of the most frequently executed button with the prefix \"Most frequent action: [Tile Name]\".
Auditory Cue (Most Frequent Action):\nSpeaks the name of the %1$d. most frequently executed button with the prefix \"%1$d. Most frequent action: [Tile Name]\".
Auditory Cue (Previous Action):\nSpeaks the name of the last executed button with the prefix \"Last action: [Tile Name]\".
Auditory Cue (Previous Action):\nSpeaks the name of the %1$d. last executed button with the prefix \"%1$d. Last action: [Tile Name]\".
Auditory Cue (Smart Prediction):\nUses the default auditory cue of the predicted button/page (without any additional prefix).
